title: Book To Comic Grounding Profile 1.0
description: Adaptation-constraint scores for one book: what this world is bound by, and therefore what must be researched before drawing it. Written by the host at plan time; see references/grounding/GROUNDING-MATRIX.md.

rationales.description: One evidence sentence per dimension scoring >= 3 (what in the book demands this).

copyright_status.description: public_domain: free to adapt (source_edition required — a modern translation of a PD original is NOT automatically PD). in_copyright without license: personal-use only; compose-project refuses the public bundle. licensed: the license object below is required.

source_edition.description: Required for public_domain: the exact edition/translation adapted (e.g. 人民文学出版社 1982 版《西游记》). The original being PD does not clear a modern translation or annotated edition.

license.description: Required for copyright_status=licensed. Self-reported declaration, not a verified grant — it must be concrete enough for a human to stand behind.

proof_note.description: Where the proof lives (contract file, email thread, page URL).

valid_until.description: Optional: expiry date if the grant is time-limited.

real_person_or_private_source.description: True when the source depicts identifiable real people or was privately provided (memoir, letters, user upload). Public export then requires consent_note.

consent_note.description: Who consented, to what, when — required for public export when real_person_or_private_source is true.

professional_review_note.description: Required for public export when procedural >= 4 (medical/legal/dosage/dangerous procedure): who with what qualification reviewed the facts, and when. Self-reported — this module records declarations and enforces their consistency; it is NOT a legal or professional review itself.

era_delta.description: When multiple eras share a panel: explicit statement of the visual differences, or an explicit statement that the source says there are none (桃花源记 悉如外人).

contradiction_register.description: Contradictions inside the source text. Register them; never fix them.
